title: Tic tac toe with an unbeatable or easy computer
when: The user wants tic tac toe for two players or against the computer, with a hard mode that never loses and an easy mode for kids.
prompt:
Goal: A tiny game with perfect rules, an opponent that matches the chosen level, and full keyboard play.
Steps:
1. Board array of 9 (null, X, O); logic.mjs winner(board) checks 8 lines and returns { player, line }, "draw" or null.
2. Hard: minimax scoring 10 minus depth so it wins fastest and never loses; Easy: random legal move, taking an immediate win 30 percent of the time.
3. 9 buttons in a CSS grid with aria-label "Row 1, column 2, empty"; filled cells disabled; arrow keys move focus.
4. Modes two players or versus computer; choose who starts; the computer moves after 300 ms with input locked.
5. Status in aria-live ("Your turn, X", "Draw"); winning line highlighted with a class.
6. Scores for X, O and draws in localStorage guarded; New round and Reset.
7. test.mjs: every line, draw, hard never loses against all human move sequences.
Quality bar:
- Hard mode verified exhaustively.
- Clear whose turn it is.
- Cells at least 80 px.
Pitfalls:
- Clicks during the computer delay.
- Winner check after a draw is declared.
- X and O shown only by color.
Verify:
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Buttons labeled and typed.
- [ ] Minimax tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (rules and minimax), test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo da velha contra o computador
examples.output: Easy/Hard select, 3x3 buttons, "Computer wins", score X 2 O 1 draws 3
